import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
n = 1000
k = rng.integers(0, 3, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 8, (3, 10))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 10)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(10)])
m = 80
k2 = rng.integers(0, 3, m)
df2 = pd.DataFrame(centers[k2] + rng.normal(0, 1, (m, 10)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(10)])

steps.name: count non-white pixels in base-only PNG
steps.eval: const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = h.png; }); const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = img.width; cv.height = img.height; cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = cv.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height).data; let n = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k+1] + d[k+2] > 100) n++; window.__pngPixelsBase = n

steps.name: wait for overlay XY
steps.until: (() => { const ov = a.layers.find(l => l.kind === 'point-overlay'); return ov && (a.overlayFilled.get(ov.id) ?? 0) >= (a.overlayNKept.get(ov.id) ?? 1); })()

steps.name: count non-white pixels in overlay PNG
steps.eval: const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = h.png; }); const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = img.width; cv.height = img.height; cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = cv.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height).data; let n = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k+1] + d[k+2] > 100) n++; window.__pngPixelsOverlay = n
steps.report: { pngPixelsBase: window.__pngPixelsBase, pngPixelsOverlay: window.__pngPixelsOverlay, diff: window.__pngPixelsOverlay - window.__pngPixelsBase }
